run_generic_agent_cli: run the generic agent CLI with --input to send a prompt and get an LLM-powered response
run_generic_agent_task: run the generic agent in one-shot task mode using --task with file-based input and output directories
run_generic_agent_reflect: run the generic agent in reflect mode with --reflect to periodically trigger tasks from a monitoring script
run_generic_agent_interactive: run the generic agent in interactive mode with stdin input and streaming output
run_generic_agent_background: run the generic agent in background mode with --bg to launch as a subprocess and print its PID
